David Robinson

David Maurice Robinson

(The Admiral, D-Rob)

Position: Center ▪ Shoots: Left

7-1, 235lb (216cm, 106kg)

Born: August 6, 1965 in Key West, Florida us

College: United States Naval Academy

High School: Osbourn Park in Manassas, Virginia

Draft: San Antonio Spurs, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 1987 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: November 4, 1989

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2009 (Full List)

Career Length: 14 years

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is David Robinson?

David Robinson is 60 years old.

Where was David Robinson born?

David Robinson was born in Key West, Florida.

When was David Robinson born?

David Robinson was born on August 6, 1965.

How tall is David Robinson?

David Robinson is 7-1 (216 cm) tall.

How much did David Robinson weigh when playing?

David Robinson weighed 235 lbs (106 kg) when playing.

Is David Robinson in the Hall of Fame?

David Robinson was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2009 (Full List) .

When was David Robinson drafted?

David Robinson was drafted by San Antonio Spurs, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 1987 NBA Draft.

What position did David Robinson play?

Center.

When did David Robinson retire?

David Robinson last played in 2003.

What is David Robinson's net worth?

David Robinson made at least $119,000,123 playing professional basketball.

How much did David Robinson make?

David Robinson made $14,841,000 in 1999.

What did David Robinson average?

David Robinson averaged 21.1 points, 10.6 rebounds, and 2.5 assists per game.

How many rings does David Robinson have?

David Robinson won 2 championships.

What schools did David Robinson attend?

David Robinson attended Osbourn Park in Manassas, Virginia and United States Naval Academy.

What are David Robinson's nicknames?

The Admiral, D-Rob are nicknames for David Robinson.
